reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: Where has Jean just arrived from?
questions.evidence: I’ve just flown in from Boston.
questions.explanation: Jean用have just flown in from说明刚乘飞机从Boston到来。题目问出发地，不是她现在所在的Washington, D.C.，也没有要求根据姓名推断家乡。其他城市虽可能是旅行地点，但不是这里说出的信息。

spokenEvidence.quote: I’ve just flown in from Boston.

questions.prompt: What kind of museum does Jean say she wants to see?
options: A museum she visits every week.
questions.evidence: I want to see an unusual museum.
questions.explanation: Jean明确说想看an unusual museum，重点是不同寻常、有特色。她没有限定必须是军事博物馆；她刚到这个城市，也没有说每周都去同一家。不要用Anna随后建议的具体主题替代Jean最先给出的总体要求。

spokenEvidence.quote: I want to see an unusual museum.

questions.prompt: What is new to Jean about the Sculpture Garden?
options: She has never heard the word garden.
She has never visited Washington before this conversation.
She has never seen a garden containing sculptures.
answers: She has never seen a garden containing sculptures.
questions.evidence: I have never seen a garden of sculptures!
questions.explanation: Jean说never seen a garden of sculptures，未体验的是“摆放雕塑的花园”这一组合。不能扩大为从未听过garden这个词；她是否曾来过华盛顿也不是这句现在完成时所说明的内容。

spokenEvidence.quote: I have never seen a garden of sculptures!

questions.prompt: How does Anna describe the Museum of the American Indian?
questions.evidence: I’ve visited that museum many times. It is very peaceful.
questions.explanation: Anna先说明多次参观过that museum，再用peaceful形容它。指代承接前面提到的Museum of the American Indian。crowded和noisy不是她给出的评价；不能把城市常见印象带入具体台词。

spokenEvidence.quote: I’ve visited that museum many times. It is very peaceful.

questions.prompt: Why is Anna familiar with farm animals but not zoo animals?
options: She grew up on a farm and has never visited a zoo.
She works at a zoo but avoids the animal areas.
She has only lived in Washington for one day.
answers: She grew up on a farm and has never visited a zoo.
questions.evidence:
Anna: I've never been to D.C.’s zoo. I've never been to any zoos!

Jean: You have never seen zoo animals?

Anna: I grew up on a farm, Jean. I've known farm animals my whole life.
questions.explanation: Anna一方面说从没去过任何动物园，另一方面说从小在农场长大、一直熟悉农场动物。两部分共同解释经验差异。她住在华盛顿已超过一年，不是一天，也没有说自己在动物园工作。

spokenEvidence.quote: I've never been to D.C.’s zoo. I've never been to any zoos!
I grew up on a farm, Jean. I've known farm animals my whole life.

questions.prompt: What does Anna say the tourist helped her do?
options: Move from the farm to Washington.
Find a job at a museum.
Discover more of the city where she lives.
answers: Discover more of the city where she lives.
questions.evidence: Jean, the tourist, helped me see more of my city.
questions.explanation: 结尾Anna总结，游客Jean帮助自己看到本城更多地方。她原本以为很熟悉城市，却从游客那里得知动物园；这里说的是发现与参观经验，不是搬家或获得博物馆工作。

spokenEvidence.quote: Jean, the tourist, helped me see more of my city.
